# ChatManager

> **File:** `services/apps/ChatManager.qml` · **Docs:** see [docs/dev](../../README.md)

The chat: conversations, sending and streaming replies (ChatRequest, ChatProtocol), attachments, and their history on disk. Every Chat module shows the one current conversation. A conversation is { id, title, created, updated, preset, provider, model, messages }; a message is { role: "user" | "assistant", text, time, and for a reply: thinking, blocks (the provider's raw content, for thinking signatures), provider, model, state: "streaming" | "done" | "stopped" | "error", error, errorKind: "auth" | "nokey" | "network" | "", notice: "refusal" | "length" | "", thinkingMs; for a user message: attachments [{ path, mime, name }] }. Saved as $XDG_STATE_HOME/axiom/chats/<id>.json, with index.json listing them and <id>/ holding attachments, up to Chat.keepConversations. axiom ipc chat open axiom ipc chat newChat axiom ipc chat ask "question" axiom ipc chat settings

### Properties

- `conversations` (var): Summaries, newest first: { id, title, updated, preset, provider, model }
- `conversation` (var): Set once the config is read (a binding here would start a new conversation on every config change)
- `messages` (readonly var)
- `busy` (readonly bool): The reply streaming in: its text and thinking so far (the last message, while its state is "streaming", reads these)
- `streamingText` (string)
- `streamingThinking` (string)
- `streamStarted` (real): When the reply started, and its thinking ended (0 while it thinks)
- `thinkingEnded` (real)
- `attachments` (var): Images waiting to go with the next message
- `attaching` (bool): Attaching (a clipboard read or screenshot) in progress
- `notice` (string): A short-lived problem to show under the composer ("" when none)
- `preset` (readonly var)
- `provider` (readonly var)
- `model` (readonly string)
- `chatDir` (readonly string)
- `persistent` (readonly bool)
- `maxImageBytes` (readonly int): Largest image a provider takes (Anthropic's limit; the others allow more)

### Functions

- `newConversation(presetName)`
- `open(id)`
- `rename(id, title)`
- `remove(id)`
- `setPreset(name)`
- `setModel(providerId, model)`
- `send(text)`
- `ask(text)`: A new conversation with the default preset, on the overlay's chat page
- `stop()`
- `regenerate()`: The last reply again (after an error, or for a different answer)
- `removeMessage(index)`
- `copy(text)`
- `openSettings()`: Settings → Chat (keys, providers, presets)
- `openPage()`: Opens the overlay on the page with the (biggest) Chat module, else an edge menu with one (moving the cursor into it)
- `attachClipboard()`
- `attachScreenshot()`: Closes the overlay, lets you pick a region (ScreenshotManager's picker), then reopens on the chat
- `attachFile(url)`: A file dropped on the chat (a file:// URL)
- `detach(index)`
